subject.title: ScreenCaptureKit transient-denial retry swallows cancellation (second attempt after cancel)

question: Does the real `SCStreamErrorDomain` runner proof in the open combined PR satisfy the prior ScreenCaptureKit proof gate, or must the contributor still demonstrate a signed true-TCC-denial path and live permission-probe cancellation?
rationale: The reported implementation is narrow and the issue presents positive live runner evidence, but the previously stated acceptance boundary was specifically signed ScreenCaptureKit/TCC proof or an owner waiver; only a maintainer can relax or interpret that gate.

options.title: Require the remaining live proof
options.body: Keep the prior gate and request signed true-TCC-denial evidence plus a live permission-probe cancellation run before landing the combined fix.

options.title: Waive the remaining proof gaps
options.body: Accept the real runner transcript and focused tests as sufficient for this narrow cancellation fix, explicitly waiving the signed TCC and permission-probe requirements.

recommendation.title: Require the remaining live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the prior gate and request signed true-TCC-denial evidence plus a live permission-probe cancellation run before landing the combined fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier combined-fix closeout recorded this person as the source of the proof-or-waiver criterion.
